supported: In actual_calibration_bank mode, original and compressed provider compositions returned numerically equivalent complete joint logp and ordered 662-coordinate gradients at the same two saved points for the first protected parent. Reported maximum absolute discrepancies: logp 0, gradient 1.4210854715202004e-14, poll logp 8.881784197001252e-16, rates 0, factor logp 8.881784197001252e-16.

At those states, the compared component inventories, poll contribution, rates, factor contributions, and non-measurement provider roster met the comparison's equality checks. This supports unchanged factor/evidence ownership between these two compositions for this selected contract, not independent validity or independence of source observations.

Each arm also recorded six central finite-difference checks at one perturbed point. This is a useful local numerical check, but it is a selected-coordinate check, not an independent proof of all 662 derivatives.
not_established: All-parent normalization: only the first protected parent was evaluated. The eight .125 masses were authenticated as protected context, but were not inserted into target logp and no per-parent marginal likelihood, conditional normalizer, or normalized mixture weights were calculated. Thus the run does not establish downstream normalization or equivalence after integrating/updating across all eight parents.

Full inference: no chain, optimizer, posterior approximation, convergence/ESS diagnostics, posterior draw comparison, or full-vector finite-difference validation was performed. Two point evaluations do not show sampling behavior or posterior equivalence over support.

Calibration or forecast quality: no held-out cycle, predictive distribution, proper score, coverage, or calibration statistic was computed. The comparison tests representation equivalence, not election-model accuracy.

Performance: the arm wall times (258.50 s original; 207.29 s compressed) include separate compilation/evaluation under distinct fresh arm caches and sequential execution. They are not a controlled throughput or memory benchmark and do not prove a speedup or resource advantage.

Historical replay, target identity aliasing, external source truth, and robustness to other admitted modes/poll selections are not established. Contract explicitly selects actual_calibration_bank; incumbent_reduction is outside this actual run.

single_next_test.name: Eight-parent normalized evidence and posterior-predictive parity
single_next_test.question: Does the two-provider representation preserve the full protected-parent mixture after each parent's conditional evidence is normalized, and do resulting predictive summaries remain the same?
single_next_test.design: Use a separately versioned, matched all-eight-parent evaluation with identical frozen target-coordinate proposal/draws and original .125 parent masses. For every parent, compute each arm's conditional log evidence using the same validated integration or importance-sampling procedure, include the parent mass exactly once, normalize parent weights with log-sum-exp, and compare parent-wise conditional posterior summaries plus combined held-out predictive distributions. Predeclare ESS/error criteria for the evidence estimator and check evidence ownership across factors. Do not infer all-parent equivalence from the first-parent calculation. This is the highest-value next test because it addresses the main unresolved scientific composition step; it is not a calibration test unless evaluated on genuinely held-out outcomes.
single_next_test.caveat: The current comparison artifacts cannot answer this question; the proposed test needs new per-parent integration/evaluation data. It must be a new attempt with an independent source/resource review, not a replay of or mutation to attempt-v1.

review_scope: Read-only interpretation of pinned design, contract, comparison, arm receipts, and predecessor provider evidence. No graph rerun, fit, sample, or artifact mutation.
